terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.introduction: These Terms explain how you may use ginhawa, what its wellbeing features can offer, and the responsibilities that come with your account. Read them together with our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: About ginhawa
sections.body: ginhawa is a student wellbeing support application developed as a BSCS capstone at STI College Caloocan. It offers stress and psychological-distress self-assessments, daily mood check-ins, stress-factor calibration, wellbeing recommendations, personal history, and consultation scheduling. Its development as a capstone does not imply official school endorsement, clinical validation, or approval for institutional deployment.

sections.title: Who may participate
sections.body: The intended student pilot is for participants aged 18 and above who meet the participation arrangements explained by the research team. If you are under 18, do not register or submit personal wellbeing information for this pilot. Use your own identity and provide accurate account and student information. Student-number validation alone does not verify your age or enrollment.

sections.title: Your account and responsible use
sections.body:
Keep your sign-in details secure and do not share your account. You may sign in using the authentication methods offered in the app, including email/password or Google. Do not impersonate another person, access someone else’s records, submit another person’s private information, interfere with the service, or bypass security controls. Avoid including names, contact details, passwords, or other identifying information in optional reflections or custom entries.

Signing out, uninstalling the app, and deleting an account are different actions. Signing out or uninstalling does not erase records already stored online.

sections.title: Wellbeing support, not diagnosis or emergency care
sections.body:
ginhawa supports reflection and general wellbeing. An assessment score or category is not a medical or psychological diagnosis. General Recommendations, AI Recommendations, activity guides, and videos do not replace advice, assessment, or treatment from a qualified professional. No particular improvement is guaranteed. Suggestions are optional; stop an activity if it feels uncomfortable.

ginhawa is not an emergency response service. Scores, mood entries, and messages are not continuously monitored, and entering a serious concern does not guarantee that someone will contact you. If you need urgent help, seek immediate assistance from local emergency services, a qualified professional, or a nearby trusted person when safe.

sections.title: AI-Generated Wellness Recommendations
sections.body:
ginhawa provides AI-assisted wellness recommendations through Cloudflare Workers AI using the Gemma model when the service and your account preference are enabled. Assessments, General Recommendations, saved history and support resources remain available. There is no active fallback to Google Gemini in this version.

When enabled, selected assessment information, selected stress factors, relevant same-day moods and assigned General Recommendations are processed through the authenticated Cloudflare gateway as described in the Privacy Policy. Read the updated notice before use. Accepting these Terms does not replace any separately required permission or research-participation consent.

AI guidance is informational and optional support, not a diagnosis, professional evaluation, medical advice or prescribed treatment. Suitability and improvement are not guaranteed. Seek qualified help when needed. Accepting these Terms or the Privacy Policy does not enable AI. On the first-use medical disclaimer, the AI toggle starts on for the full ginhawa experience. You can turn it off before continuing; your choice is saved only when you continue. When on, personalized guidance requires sending selected wellness information to Cloudflare. Leaving it off uses General Recommendations without new AI processing. You can change this choice anytime in Settings → Privacy & AI → AI recommendations. Turning AI off prevents new recommendation requests from this version to Cloudflare. Assessments, General Recommendations, support resources and saved AI guidance remain available. Requests already sent cannot be recalled. Service-wide availability controls and daily limits override your enabled preference.

AI cards and optional guides are generated together and saved with the assessment. See More and historical views make no new model request. Daily limits affect AI generation only; results, General Recommendations and support resources remain available. Thesis post-testing remains voluntary under the applicable participant consent procedures.

sections.title: Consultation requests and support resources
sections.body:
Scheduling lets you request an appointment through the existing Guidance Associate workflow. A request is not a confirmed appointment until an authorized Associate accepts it. Check the status and notifications for updates. Availability, response times, and support outcomes are not guaranteed. Administrative participation in testing does not establish professional qualifications or authorization to provide counseling.

Support Resources may help you find services outside ginhawa. Their availability and terms are controlled by those services. Do not rely on an unconfirmed consultation request when urgent help is needed.

sections.title: Your information and participation choices
sections.body:
The Privacy Policy explains the information handled by the student app and related administrative features. Optional reflections and activities remain your choice. Agreeing to these Terms and acknowledging the Privacy Policy do not waive your privacy rights or give blanket permission for unrelated research. Any additional research use or processing that requires separate permission must be explained appropriately.

You may stop using the app. Stopping participation does not automatically delete existing records; contact the research team to discuss your privacy request and available options.

sections.title: Account-deletion requests
sections.body:
Students may submit an account-deletion request through Settings → Account using their own verified Firebase sign-in. Submission requires confirmation and recent password or Google reauthentication. Requests are stored securely in Firestore; submitting a request does not immediately delete or disable the account. An authorized Super Admin reviews ownership in the trusted local management system and separately confirms permanent deletion. We target completion within 30 calendar days after ownership verification.

Permanent deletion removes the Firebase sign-in account, profile and nested records, assessments and saved guidance, moods, stress factors, calibration, feedback, problem reports, preferences, linked consultation application records and notifications, and identifiable derived reports. Unrelated students’ records and shared guidance associate availability are preserved. Your student number remains reserved to prevent reassignment; the reservation has no profile or account link. No wellness information is retained for research or analytics after deletion.

You may view Pending, Processing, or Failed status while your account remains active. Access ends when permanent processing begins. An interrupted operation stays available for the operator to retry safely; it is not treated as completed until cleanup is verified. A minimal completed audit is retained for 90 days, without your name, email, student number, account identifier, or wellness content, then removed through local maintenance. Provider-held copies and disconnected devices follow the limits explained in the Privacy Policy.

If you cannot sign in, first use password recovery or your existing Google account. If that fails, email ginhawa.support@gmail.com for operator-assisted recovery. An authorized operator must establish ownership through an approved recovery process; a student number alone is insufficient. Do not send passwords. Permanent processing is available through authorized local Super Admin operators, requires explicit confirmation for each case, and never happens automatically on submission. These Terms do not establish institutional approval.

sections.title: Availability, changes, and your rights
sections.body:
ginhawa is a prototype and may experience errors, maintenance, connection problems, or interruptions. Do not rely on it as your only source of support or your only record of an important appointment. Keep important appointment details somewhere you can access independently.

These Terms may be revised to reflect the service and its approved arrangements. Material changes should be brought to your attention before the changed terms or processing applies, with renewed permission where required. Nothing here removes rights or responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable Philippine law.

sections.title: Questions
sections.body: For app support, account-deletion help, or privacy concerns, email ginhawa.support@gmail.com. The project contributors are listed in About Us. Never send your password or unnecessary personal wellbeing information by email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains what information ginhawa handles, why it is used, who may receive it, and the choices available to you. It covers the student app and the related administrative handling of student records; the public marketing website has its own notice.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your information
sections.body:
ginhawa is developed by the capstone research team listed in About Us. The team proposes to operate the student pilot. The accountable operator, designated privacy representative, and responsibilities of any participating institution have not yet been formally finalized. Identifying STI College Caloocan as the project’s school does not establish institutional control, endorsement, or approval.

For support, deletion assistance, or privacy concerns, contact ginhawa.support@gmail.com. The appointment of an accountable operator and designated privacy representative still requires confirmation before real-student release.

sections.title: Information you provide
sections.body:
Account and student details: your account identifier, name, email, sign-in method, and student information such as student number, course, and section. Student-number ownership information helps prevent duplicate use. Firebase Authentication handles credentials; ginhawa does not store your password in your wellbeing profile.

Wellbeing records: assessment answers, scores, categories, dates and histories; mood check-ins and optional custom reflections; selected stress factors and calibration; general and AI recommendations, including saved guides; and recommendation feedback and preferences. These entries may reveal sensitive health or educational information.

Consultation records: the requesting student, selected Associate, appointment time, status, notifications, booking references, and related request or status details. Avoid including information about other people that they have not authorized you to share.

sections.title: Optional problem reports
sections.body: If you use Report a problem in Settings, ginhawa stores your account identifier, chosen category, title, description, submission date, and report status in Firestore for troubleshooting. Active Super Admins can review the report, change its status, and leave an update that you can read in the app. The most recent update records the responsible administrator and date. Reports do not automatically include assessment answers, mood records, device logs, or screenshots. Do not put passwords or private wellbeing details in a report. Reports are included in the proposed account-deletion scope and are not an emergency-support channel.

sections.title: Device storage and service information
sections.body:
The app can keep account-owned drafts, pending uploads, and cached records on your device. It also stores preferences such as theme, music, and onboarding acknowledgments. Firebase and Google services may handle technical information, including network, device, authentication, and security information, to provide and protect their services.

Protect access to devices you share with others. Signing out does not mean every device or service cache has been erased, and uninstalling the app does not delete online records.

sections.title: Why information is used
sections.body:
Information supports account registration and authentication, account isolation, student-number uniqueness, saved assessment and mood history, personalized wellbeing guidance, consultation scheduling and updates, and access by authorized support personnel. Related administrative features provide assessment monitoring, wellbeing summaries, and consultation management within the permitted role.

The intended pilot evaluates functionality, usability, reliability, and user acceptance, not clinical effectiveness. A lawful basis appropriate to each purpose and any sensitive information must be established before collection. This notice is an explanation of processing, not blanket consent to all uses. Optional entries and any additional research use must be handled under appropriate notice and permission where required.

sections.title: AI-Assisted Recommendations and Third-Party Data Processing
sections.body:
ginhawa uses Cloudflare Workers AI (Gemma), through an authenticated Cloudflare Worker, for AI-assisted recommendations when the service and your account preference are enabled. Previously saved recommendations remain available; opening results or See More does not generate again.

When a configured app contacts the gateway, Cloudflare processes Firebase authentication and App Check tokens to verify the account and application. Those tokens contain account or technical identifiers; they are not sent to the language model. Authorized Firebase reads supply the saved assessment, selected factors and relevant same-day mood context.

The model input is limited to the assessment type, score and classification, selected stress factors, relevant same-day moods or optional reflections, and assigned General Recommendations. Names, email addresses, student numbers and Firebase UIDs are not intentionally included in model input. Known identifiers and obvious identifying patterns are removed from free text, but this does not guarantee anonymity. Do not enter identifying information in custom fields. Wellness context can still reveal sensitive information.

Cloudflare states that Workers AI inference content is not used to train models and is not retained after processing, subject to its documented legal and security exceptions. Operational metadata and the terms for any separately enabled storage features are distinct. ginhawa does not enable prompt/output logging, AI Gateway storage or model response caching. Provider terms and safeguards must be reviewed for the pilot; no complete-anonymity or immediate-provider-erasure promise is made.

AI guidance is supportive and educational, not diagnosis or treatment. General Recommendations use predefined rules without model processing. Agreeing to the Terms or acknowledging this Policy does not enable AI. On the first-use medical disclaimer, the AI toggle starts on for the full ginhawa experience and you can turn it off before continuing. Continuing saves the separate choice; no AI generation is started by that screen. Personalized AI guidance sends selected wellness data to Cloudflare. Turning the toggle off uses non-AI General Recommendations. You can change this choice in Settings → Privacy & AI → AI recommendations. The choice is saved on your own Firebase profile and applies across devices using this version after synchronization. When off, new recommendation requests are not sent to Cloudflare; assessments continue to be saved in Firebase for history and General Recommendations. If an off-setting cannot synchronize, it remains off locally and the app offers a sync retry for other devices. Re-enabling requires a confirmed connection. Turning AI off does not erase saved guidance or recall requests already sent. A service-wide kill switch and daily quotas override an enabled preference; if your preference cannot be verified, the app uses General Recommendations.

Minimal quota records in Cloudflare D1 contain pseudonymous keyed identifiers, UTC dates, counters, timestamps and status, without wellness content. Records older than seven days are removed by maintenance; recoverable provider copies may follow D1 Free Time Travel’s documented seven-day lifecycle. Daily limits reset at 8:00 AM Philippine time. Account-deletion handling must account for this operational metadata and provider lifecycle.

For privacy questions, email ginhawa.support@gmail.com. The responsible operator and designated privacy representative still require confirmation.

sections.title: Important AI-provider limitation
sections.body:
Changing provider does not itself approve sensitive student-data processing. The Cloudflare processor arrangement, cross-border handling, participant notice and appropriate permission still require review before real-student AI activation. The server remains disabled until separately approved.

Older ginhawa versions may have used Google Gemini/Firebase AI Logic. Their previously generated recommendations remain in saved assessment history until deletion. This release does not send new inference requests to that route. Provider-held historical copies remain subject to the terms and lifecycles that applied when they were processed; this notice does not retroactively change those terms.

sections.title: Who may access or receive information
sections.body:
Authorized Guidance Associates and administrative personnel access student records only within assigned permissions and authorized purposes. Super Admin account-management permissions do not automatically grant access to all wellness records. Authorized maintainers may need access to operate or secure the system. Administrative testing alone is not authorization to view sensitive student information.

Firebase and Google provide authentication, storage and application security. A configured AI gateway uses Cloudflare for authenticated request handling and minimal quota storage; when enabled for your account and the service, Workers AI processes the minimized model context described above. These providers may process information outside the Philippines. External support links and Google sign-in have their own provider policies. This draft does not authorize advertising use or sale of wellness information.

sections.title: How long information is kept
sections.body:
Account-linked records are stored to support the disclosed app functions and the agreed pilot arrangements. The retention schedule for active accounts has not yet been finalized; this draft does not authorize indefinite storage or promise a deletion date that the system cannot enforce. The retention schedule and responsible operator must be confirmed and communicated before real-student release.

Wellness information is not to be retained after verified account deletion for future research, analytics, or administrative convenience. Any legal or professional requirement to keep a specific record must be identified, limited to what is necessary, and explained rather than assumed.

sections.title: Account deletion and remaining copies
sections.body:
The default is to permanently delete student-associated personal information after ownership verification and explicit operator confirmation. This covers Authentication, the profile and all nested collections, student-linked assessment records and guides, moods, stress factors, calibration, feedback, preferences, problem reports, consultations and notifications, reservation references, and identifiable derived reports. Other students’ information and shared guidance associate availability are preserved. An empty student-number reservation remains to prevent reassignment, without the deleted profile or UID mapping. It is a retained number reservation, not a claim that the number is anonymous.

Deletion requests are stored in Firestore with a case reference, requester UID, status, and server timestamps. Recent verified Firebase sign-in and explicit student confirmation are required for submission. Students can read their own request but cannot verify ownership, approve processing, change privileged fields, or complete deletion. The trusted local Admin SDK worker is used only by authorized Super Admin operators. Processing is manual, not an automatic deletion trigger. We target completion within 30 calendar days after verification. Submission alone does not delete the account. A request is received only after server confirmation; refresh status after an uncertain connection before retrying.

While a request is Pending, it awaits verification or processing. Processing means permanent cleanup has begun and protected access ends. Failed means the operator must safely resume the existing case. Completed is recorded only after application-data cleanup and Authentication removal have been verified. You can check status in the app while your account remains active; after access ends, use the verified operator recovery route for follow-up.

Once completed, the request is replaced with minimal audit metadata: case reference, outcome, submission/verification/completion timestamps, verifying and processing operator references, and expiry. It does not retain student name, email, student number, UID, or wellness content. Completed audits are kept for 90 days from completion and removed by the operator’s local maintenance process. Unfinished cases keep only the identity and processing state needed for safe recovery until resolved. The operator must monitor overdue cases and run expiry maintenance regularly; no cloud scheduler or automatic TTL is assumed.

For lost account access, try Firebase password recovery or the original Google sign-in first. If unsuccessful, email ginhawa.support@gmail.com for operator-assisted recovery. Any further identity check must be handled by an authorized operator using the approved recovery procedure and only necessary evidence. A student number by itself is insufficient. Never send passwords or unnecessary identity documents. The support mailbox must be monitored, and authorized recovery personnel and verification procedures must be confirmed before real-student release.

Application-controlled device drafts and caches are cleared when account removal can be detected; a disconnected device cannot be remotely wiped immediately. Deleting Firestore records does not mean all provider-held logs, replicas, or any verified backups have expired. Their actual configured and documented lifecycles govern removal. Permanent processing uses the activated local operator workflow and requires recent operator authentication and explicit confirmation for each case. No blanket retention exception or immediate removal of every copy is promised.

sections.title: Your rights and choices
sections.body:
Subject to applicable Philippine law, you may request information about processing, access your personal data, seek correction of inaccurate records, object to processing, withdraw consent where consent is the legal basis, and request erasure or blocking where appropriate. Other applicable rights, including portability or remedies, depend on the circumstances. You may raise a complaint with the National Privacy Commission.

For privacy requests, email ginhawa.support@gmail.com. Verification may be needed to protect your account; only information necessary for the request should be sought. Do not submit passwords or unnecessary identity documents. Withdrawing consent does not automatically make earlier lawful processing unlawful, and any specific obligation affecting a request should be explained. Acknowledging this notice does not waive your rights.

sections.title: Security and updates
sections.body:
ginhawa uses authentication, account separation, role permissions, and security rules to restrict access. These safeguards reduce risk but cannot guarantee absolute security. Keep your sign-in details secure and report suspected unauthorized access to ginhawa.support@gmail.com.

Material changes to the purposes, recipients, or handling of your information should be communicated before the changed processing begins, with renewed permission where required.
